_comment: Copy to config/local/grvt_maker.json (git-ignored). Shadow needs no keys; live needs live_enabled true, --live and the secrets file (chmod 600); deploy/live/grvt-maker/start.sh does all of it. Sized for a 200 USDT canary: 50 USDT orders, at most 150 USDT per symbol (300 for both, 1.5x). XRP at +/-0.25 bps (most fills, measures how often a crossed quote fills); ADA at +/-2 bps (positive in replay under both fill models). skew 0.5 bps per 50 USDT lot is the replay's 1 bps per 100 USDT.
